title: kith-attach: orphaned .tmp on rename failure
description: write_blob (line 136) and write_blob_streaming (line 233) call tokio::fs::rename and return Err on failure without removing the .tmp file. The error paths for write/flush/sync all call remove_file, but the rename path does not. On a cross-device rename or permissions failure, the .tmp file is left on disk indefinitely, potentially accumulating. Fix: wrap rename with cleanup-on-error in both functions.
